name: Kasthuri Jayarajah
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
fitReason: Relevant CS/HRI systems work connects wearable gaze, pose and depth sensing with robot decisions, while a broader edge-AI program studies collaborative deep perception. Stronger on sensing, interaction and system integration than end-to-end robot policy learning.

physicalEvidence.summary: The official MobiSys 2026 public review of ConCord confirms an end-to-end AR/HMD–robot prototype and initial real-world deployment as well as simulations, using implicit human signals for complementary exploration. It warns that human-behavior modeling uses simple proxies and evaluation is limited. NJIT’s March 27, 2026 report independently identifies Jayarajah presenting an actual robot dog driven through a wearable/VR interface. Exact ConCord robot model and full manuscript methods were not retrieved; no claim is made that it uses learned navigation, RL or a foundation model. Her current homepage explicitly identifies its first authors as her students.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master’s visitor route was verified. The hiring page still describes Fall 2023 PhD recruitment and independent projects for NJIT students. Earlier UMBC summer-mentor experience and cross-institution advising are precedent, not a current short-visit invitation. Use the current NJIT directory email rather than the older UMBC address on that hiring page.
